$description: Sunken - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Sunken
line: A dive from the sunlit lagoon to the abyss: water-glass panels, sea-glass buttons, mother-of-pearl focus, contour charts, and the creatures that live at each depth.

voice.searchph: Search the depths: components, tokens, patterns
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, from the sunlit lagoon down to the abyssal floor. Scroll to dive.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. This one is a dive: the further you read, the deeper the water, from the lagoon to the abyss.
voice.lede.typography: Instrument Serif sets the titles like the captions on a natural-history plate; Hanken Grotesk carries the reading; Martian Mono writes depths, labels and code, like the figures on a chart.
voice.lede.card: A pane of thick, clear water: the sea bends at its edges and a thin rim catches the light from above.
voice.lede.button: Sea glass worn smooth: deep teal with a pearl sheen that shifts as the light moves. A success sends up a stream of bubbles.
voice.lede.404: Nothing down here but sand and a sea pig. Search, or swim back to the surface.
voice.copyfail: Lost to the current - select the code instead
voice.lede.chip: Chips are tumbled sea glass; the chosen one takes on the shimmer of mother-of-pearl.
